- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx`

Each file has three SVG data-URI fixtures (`PRIMARY_IMAGE`, `HOVER_IMAGE`, and a third gallery-only image inline in `GALLERY_IMAGES`), currently using dark fills `%23282828` (`#282828`), `%23707070` (`#707070`), and `%23454545` (`#454545`) respectively. Replace with three light, mutually-distinguishable shades from this codebase's own registered ivory palette (`overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts`) — deliberately kept distinct from each other, not all identical, so the hover-swap and multi-image-gallery demos these fixtures serve still visibly show something changing:

- `PRIMARY_IMAGE` fill → `%23f6f4f1` (`#f6f4f1`, `ivory[200]`, this codebase's `background['02']` alias — the exact colour Marcel asked for, whose Figma-panel name `--alias-color-bg-surface-default` isn't an actual variable in this codebase; `var(--zimm-color-bg-02)` is the real equivalent, cited in the comment, not the nonexistent Figma name)
- `HOVER_IMAGE` fill → `%23f2e9e0` (`#f2e9e0`, `ivory[400]`)
- The third gallery-only image's fill → `%23fbf5ef` (`#fbf5ef`, `ivory[300]`)

Update each fixture's own comment (they currently say something like "Visually-distinct data-URI SVGs... no network needed, keeps stories deterministic in CI") to note the fills were changed from dark to light specifically so overlaid elements (badge/close/arrows) stay visible against them, and name the three ivory shades used. Keep the comment's existing point about being deterministic/no-network — just add to it, don't remove it.

**Do not change** the `alt` text, dimensions, viewBox, or anything else about these SVGs — only the three `fill='...'` hex values, in all four files, applied identically. Do not touch any component or recipe file — these are Storybook-only fixture strings.

When done, report the exact before/after fill values for one representative file (they should be identical across all four), confirm all four files were updated identically (e.g. via a `grep -c` count matching across files), confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and confirm `npm run test -- --run` still passes (873 tests — these are `.stories.tsx` files, not executed by Vitest, but run it to be sure nothing else broke). Do not stage, do not commit.

92	 * `zimmProductCard/nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` can share one implementation instead of each

100	 * neither. Narrowing via the `variation` discriminant into a single `propsWithLiveSelection`

116	  const isSizeChipVariation = args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist';

118	  const handleSizeChipSelect = (value: string) => {
119	    setSelectedSizeChipValue(value);
120	    onSizeChipSelectFromArgs?.(value);
121	  };
122	  const propsWithLiveSelection: ZimmProductCardProps = isSizeChipVariation
123	    ? { ...args, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect: handleSizeChipSelect }
124	    : args;
125	  return <ZimmProductCard {...propsWithLiveSelection} />;
126	};
